title: Dabeli
description: Kutchi street snack of a sweet, spicy potato filling in a buttered pav, studded with peanuts, pomegranate and sev.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the butter in a pan and add the dabeli masala, stirring for 10 seconds.
Add the mashed potato, tamarind chutney and salt and cook for 3 minutes, mashing well, then cool slightly.
Mix in the roasted peanuts and half the pomegranate seeds.
Slit each pav, spread the coriander chutney inside and fill with the potato mixture.
Press a little onion and sev onto the filling and top with the remaining pomegranate seeds.
Toast the stuffed pav on a tawa with the remaining butter until golden on both sides, and serve warm.
